info.name: WareTrack-Pro API
info.description:
WareTrack-Pro API v2.3.0, hosted on Render. Every path also works under /api/v1.

Sign in:
1. Set `email` and `password` in the collection variables.
2. Run **Authentication → POST auth/login**. A 6-digit code is emailed to you.
3. Put the code in the `otp` variable and run **POST auth/verify-login-otp**. The access and refresh tokens are saved automatically.

Every other request uses `{{access_token}}` via collection-level Bearer auth. Each request's description says which roles may call it.

Notes: new self-registered accounts must be approved by an admin before they can sign in. Login is limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP. Accounts with an authenticator app enter the app's code as `otp` instead of an emailed code.
